mapper.sql: select b.id, b.version, b.month, b.type_id, b.amount, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark, case when b.type_id = 0 then '总预算' else c.type_name end as type_name from px_bookkeeping_budget b left join px_bookkeeping_classification c on b.type_id = c.id
mapper.select: select t.id, t.version, t.month, t.type_id, t.amount, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, case when t.type_id = 0 then '总预算' else t.type_name end as type_name, ifnull(s.used, 0) as used, t.amount - ifnull(s.used, 0) as remaining, least(999, round(ifnull(s.used, 0) * 100 / greatest(t.amount, 0.01))) as percent from ( select b.id, b.version, b.month, b.type_id, b.amount, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark, c.type_name from px_bookkeeping_budget b left join px_bookkeeping_classification c on b.type_id = c.id where b.del_flag = 0 and b.month = #{month} and b.create_by = #{createBy} ) t left join ( select r.type as type_id, sum(r.money) as used from px_bookkeeping_record r where r.del_flag = 0 and r.type != 0 and r.create_by = #{createBy} and DATE_FORMAT(r.pay_time, '%Y-%m') = #{month} group by r.type union all select 0 as type_id, sum(r.money) as used from px_bookkeeping_record r where r.del_flag = 0 and r.type != 0 and r.create_by = #{createBy} and DATE_FORMAT(r.pay_time, '%Y-%m') = #{month} ) s on s.type_id = t.type_id order by t.type_id = 0 desc, t.type_name
mapper.insert: insert into px_bookkeeping_budget (version, month, type_id, amount, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{version}, #{month}, #{typeId}, #{amount}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
